QuestInfo.name: The Magician of Light, Luminous
QuestInfo.0: Athena said she has news about one of the five heroes. Better find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Athena heard that Luminous was seen in Ellinia. There is no time to lose. You need to find Luminous and get some solid answers. Talk to Grendel the Really Old about the sighting.
QuestInfo.2: You came all the way to Ellinia to look for the person who saw Luminous. Although the lead is thin, you must take whatever you can get. You need to find Luminous quickly.

0.0: Shade, I searched for Luminous as you asked. It isn't much, but I received word from #rGrendel the Really Old#k in the #b#m101000003##k of Ellinia that he saw Luminous not long ago. Do you want to meet him?\r\n#r(You will be moved directly to the map if you accept.)#k

1.0: Are you here to become a Magician?
